build_cuda_extension: build a CUDA extension module named utilslib from utils.cpp and utils_kernel.cu source files
install_utils_extension: install the utils CUDA extension package by running pip install in the extensions utils directory
compile_with_nvcc: compile CUDA kernel sources with nvcc using sm_70 architecture and c++14 standard flags
setup_pytorch_extension: set up a PyTorch C++ extension using CUDAExtension and BuildExtension from torch.utils.cpp_extension
build_ext_command: build the extension module using the BuildExtension command class for CUDA compilation support
